name: gitlab-incidents-native-route
$comment: CHAOS-3361 structural closures. Each mutation removes one fetch, completeness, accounting, destination, tenant-readback, routing, or live-budget property and must drive its direct proof green to red to green.

mutations.rationale: The GitLab request must ask the production incidents endpoint for incident issues rather than ordinary issues before any normalization occurs.
Duplicate issue IDs returned across GitLab pages must not create duplicate canonical incidents or inflate the persisted batch.
A saturated accepted-row cap cannot prove the newest-first source window is exhausted and must fail before advancing the watermark.
The complete incidents unit owns exactly its three operational destinations and must not reintroduce the repository writer owned by repo-metadata.
Evidence must count physical transport attempts, including retries, rather than logical pages or successful responses.

mutations.find: FROM operational_services FINAL WHERE org_id = ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.replace: FROM operational_services FINAL WHERE org_id != ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.rationale: Retry inspection must read the service row from the claimed tenant even when another tenant has the same generated ID.

mutations.find: FROM operational_service_repository_mappings FINAL WHERE org_id = ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.replace: FROM operational_service_repository_mappings FINAL WHERE org_id != ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.rationale: Retry inspection must read the repository mapping from the claimed tenant even when another tenant has the same generated ID.

mutations.find: FROM operational_incidents FINAL WHERE org_id = ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.replace: FROM operational_incidents FINAL WHERE org_id != ? AND id = ? LIMIT 1", row.OrgID, row.ID)
mutations.rationale: Retry inspection must read the incident row from the claimed tenant even when another tenant has the same generated ID.
The capability matrix must advertise the completed GitLab incidents route as ready while preserving independent default-off enablement.

mutations.find: {Dimension: BudgetRESTCore, Units: max(1, spanDays), Confidence: "medium", RouteFamily: "issues"}
mutations.rationale: The Go preflight reservation must retain the live Python incidents estimator's issue-page growth across multi-day windows.
The differential traversal oracle must fail when the live Python producer's GitLab issue filter diverges from the Go request contract.
Every incidents destination must reject duplicate canonical IDs before appending any ClickHouse rows or allowing duplicate expectations to self-confirm in readback.
